notes: Interview question nodes. Every path a rule reads is a constrained type: enum, enum_multi, boolean, number, date, tri_state, or entity_ref. identifier and short_text are single-line text that a predicate may only presence-check with `answered`; validate.py enforces that no other operator reads them. narrative is free text that feeds the clause library and is never read by a predicate. applies_to is an engine predicate over the answer set, evaluated by the facade; it is linted by validate.py. authority_ids name entries in the content registry and are the only source of citations shown in the UI.
steps_note: The guided walk-through. A step of kind `questions` shows the listed question ids, a few at a time. `inventory`, `sort`, `followups` and `review` are computed steps the facade renders from the answer set: inventory collects devices by hand or by CSV and scanner import, sort runs criticality stage 1 over them, followups asks the per-asset questions the rules need for in-scope assets, review shows percent complete and what is missing per section. Percent complete is answered applicable items over applicable items; nothing is estimated.

questions.prompt: What kind of covered asset does this Plan cover?
questions.help: The discriminator. Question applicability and rule applicability read it.

questions.prompt: Name of the vessel, facility, or OCS facility
Cognizant Captain of the Port or OCMI
Date the Plan was approved, if it has been
questions.help: Leave empty for a Plan not yet approved. The 5-year validity rule applies only once this is answered.

questions.prompt: Is the cybersecurity organizational structure defined in writing?
Personnel with cybersecurity duties
CySO name
CySO title
Is the CySO designated in writing?
Date of the CySO designation
questions.help: No rule reads this yet. A CySO change starts the two 96-hour clocks.

questions.prompt: Is the CySO accessible to the Coast Guard 24 hours a day, 7 days a week?
questions.help: Business hours with after-hours message relay is not 24/7 accessibility.

questions.prompt: CySO 24/7 mobile number
On-call protocol for reaching the CySO at any time, if a mobile number is not the method
Alternate CySO name, if one is designated
questions.help: Permitted, not required. The definition of Cybersecurity Officer allows an alternate.

questions.prompt: Notification channels available to the CySO
Authority contacts for continuous communications
questions.help: List the actual contacts. A statement that a list is kept elsewhere is not a contact.

questions.prompt: Communications channels with interfacing vessels
Out-of-band channels that survive a compromise of email and VoIP
IT and OT inventory
questions.help: Supplied by SAM from an assessment. Editable here so the gap report can be exercised. observed_cves comes from scanner output for IT or vendor advisory mapping for OT; the KEV join is computed from it, never typed in.

fields.prompt: How vulnerabilities are identified if the asset cannot be scanned

questions.prompt: Are backups of critical IT and OT systems tested frequently?
questions.help: Tri-state: not_applicable is a different finding from no. No rule reads this yet.
